name: dsh-bridge-obsidian
description: Bridge DeepSeek Harness to Obsidian: token-authenticated WebSocket carrier plus obsidian_* vault tools executed in the connected Obsidian client, and in-host chat session bridging for the Obsidian chat panel
author: kaitzh

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @yuxianglin/dsh-bridge-obsidian run build && pnpm --filter dsh-obsidian-plugin run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @yuxianglin/dsh-bridge-obsidian run typecheck && pnpm --filter dsh-obsidian-plugin run typecheck
